name: @w6w-apps/mixmax
description: Send and schedule email, manage sequences and their recipients, and read templates, tasks, teams and unsubscribes through the Mixmax API.

w6w.longDescription:
Mixmax is an email engagement and sales-outreach platform that works inside Gmail and Outlook: tracked email, templates, scheduled sends, meeting links and multi-step sequences. This app connects a workflow to the Mixmax REST API with an API token created under Settings > Integrations.

A workflow can list and read messages, create a draft email and send it (optionally updating it first), and run sequences: list sequences and folders, add recipients with per-recipient variables and a scheduled time, list a sequence's recipients, look up a recipient's status across sequences by email, and exit recipients (or everyone) from a sequence. It can read templates and snippets, list tasks with Mixmax's task query language, read teams and their members, and manage the unsubscribe list that stops every sequence from emailing a contact.

Lists are returned as results with the cursor and a has-more flag for the next page. Health checks watch the API components of Mixmax's status page and whether the API answers, and verify the token.
